title: Context Vocabulary, Used to ve Get Used to
subtitle: Kelimeyi bağlama göre seç; eski alışkanlıkla alışma sürecini karıştırma.

learn.title: Bağlam ve alışkanlıklar
learn.intro: Tek kelimelik çeviri her bağlamda çalışmaz. Cümlenin tamamına bak. Used to geçmişte olup şimdi olmayan alışkanlık; get used to ise alışma sürecidir.

cards.title: Bağlamı genişlet
cards.text: Kelimeyi yalnız değil, kısa bir cümle içinde ara. Türünü ve örneklerini kontrol et.

cards.title: Travel words
cards.text: leave bir yerden ayrılmak, departure kalkış, journey yolculuk, return geri dönüş.

cards.title: used to + V1
cards.text: Geçmişte düzenliydi; şimdi artık doğru değil.
examples: I used to ride a bike.

cards.title: get used to + isim / -ing
examples: I am getting used to the noise.
Leo got used to waking up early.

cards.title: Vocabulary loop
cards.text: Gör → söyle → örnekte bul → kendi cümlende kullan → ertesi gün tekrar et.

read.title: A Clear Travel Plan
read.instructions: Metni iki kez oku. İlkinde ana fikri, ikincide dil ipuçlarını bul.

tokens.text: Maya is writing a travel plan for a school project.
At first, she writes “start of bus” for the time when the bus goes.
Then she checks a dictionary example and changes it to “bus departure time.”
She writes “leaving the town” for the final morning and “return journey” for the trip home.
Her plan includes watching hot-air balloons, hiking in a valley and visiting historic sites.
She checks whether each word is a noun or a verb.
Her final plan is short, clear and natural.

questions.prompt: What phrase does Maya use for the bus time?
What does she check about each word?
questions.explanation: İsim mi fiil mi diye bakıyor.

extra.title: A New Morning Routine
extra.instructions: Uzun metni oku ve ayrıntıları seç.
paragraphs: Leo moved to a new town in September. He used to walk to school because his old school was close to his home. Now he takes an early bus. During the first week, the departure time felt very early. He was tired every morning, and he sometimes forgot his travel card. He also used to eat breakfast slowly, but the new timetable changed his routine.

After a month, Leo is getting used to waking up at six. He prepares his bag the night before and checks the bus timetable in context: the bus leaves at 6:45, and the journey takes twenty minutes. He is also getting used to reading on the bus. At first, the movement made reading difficult, but now it feels normal. Leo still misses his old walk, but he likes arriving early and talking to friends before class.

questions.prompt: What is he getting used to?
What does “the bus leaves at 6:45” mean?
options: A passenger leaves the bus at 6:45.
questions.explanation: Leave bağlama göre hareket aracının kalkması.
